lines.beaver: 새해 복 많이 받아요! 올해 결심한 거 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Happy New Year! Did you make any resolutions this year?
lines.beaver_roman: saehae bok mani badayo! olhae gyeolsimhan geo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 올해는 진짜 큰 결심을 했어요.
lines.en: Yes, I made a really big resolution this year.
lines.roman: ne, olhaeneun jinjja keun gyeolsimeul haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, what is it? I'm curious.
lines.learner: 매일 아침 한 시간씩 책을 읽을 거예요.
lines.en: I'm going to read for an hour every morning.
lines.roman: maeil achim han sigansik chaegeul ilgeul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Why do you want to read books?
lines.en: Because I want to become happy.

lines.beaver_en: Happiness? Is it more important than success?
lines.en: Yes, to me happiness matters more than success.
Last year I knew nothing but work. It was so hard.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, you were really busy last year.
lines.learner: 그래서 올해는 자유 시간을 갖고 싶어요.
lines.en: So this year I want to have free time.
lines.roman: geuraeseo olhaeneun jayu siganeul gatgo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any other plans, by chance?
lines.en: On weekends I'm going to go to the mountains.

lines.beaver_en: That's cool. What books will you read?
lines.learner: 옛날 사람들의 생각에 대한 책을 읽고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to read books about the thoughts of people long ago.
lines.roman: yennal saramdeurui saenggage daehan chaegeul ilkko sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then how do you want to live from now on?
lines.en: I just want to live happily.

lines.beaver_en: What a great thought. I hope you achieve it!
lines.en: Thanks. I'll keep hope and try every day!
